text:
Maya: Heads up — CI failing on docsite build for the migration branch, looks anchor-related after the mdx heading normalization change.
Maya: Error in deploy logs: `Link to '#what-is-the-model' not found (404)`, plugin stacktrace shows `slugify('What’s the model') -> whats-the-model` vs existing `what-s-the-model`
docs-bot: Deploy preview failed — build 8675 — https://deploys.redwood.dev/8675 — see /logs
Sam: can you paste the raw heading from the MDX file? smart quotes often normalize differently
Maya: in models/overview.mdx header is: `### What’s the model` (curly apostrophe)
Ellie: aha, curly apostrophe -> slug mismatch. Docusaurus slugify on CI strips punctuation differently than local dev env. We should normalize before commit
Jin: quick fix: add explicit id `### What’s the model {#whats-the-model}` in the mdx file so the fragment is deterministic
Sam: or run `npm run docs:slugify` pre-commit to rewrite headings to ascii-friendly ids; we should add a config note for contributors
Maya: I can push a tiny PR with explicit ids if that's fastest
Ellie: please also add a short note in the PR about why — future devs will hit this, and maybe call out the docusaurus vs mkdocs difference
Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 — includes two explicit ids and a changelog entry
docs-bot: CI rerun started for PR 4212 (job: docs-build, check: link-check)
Sam: good — if CI still complains we'll add a linkcheck job that fails on missing fragments and a lint rule for smart quotes
Maya: thanks all :rocket:
